#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
cd /data/project/yuxilab/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/.omo/workspaces/41fb8bec5ebaa36bd3dc71d2dec6a49765b1d7a92396bfa22509c0ddd9d223da/source || exit 1
export CPM_SOURCE_CACHE=/u/yuxihong/.cache/CPM
mkdir -p build/overseer-options/.cmake/api/v1/query || exit 1
: > build/overseer-options/.cmake/api/v1/query/codemodel-v2
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "build", "server": "lair-cpu", "argv": ["cmake", "--preset", "openmp-examples", "-B", "build/overseer-options", "-DSPCRAFT_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON"]}'
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "status": "PENDING", "stage": "configure", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'
if srun --nodes=1 --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=4 bash -c 'printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "status": "RUNNING", "stage": "configure", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'"'"'
cmake --preset openmp-examples -B build/overseer-options -DSPCRAFT_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON'; then
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "status": "SUCCESS", "stage": "configure", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'
else
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "status": "FAILURE", "stage": "configure", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "build_failed", "server": "lair-cpu"}'

printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "build", "server": "lair-cpu", "argv": ["cmake", "--build", "build/overseer-options", "--target", "bench_ompspmv", "--parallel", "4"]}'
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "status": "PENDING", "stage": "build", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'
if srun --nodes=1 --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=4 bash -c 'printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "status": "RUNNING", "stage": "build", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'"'"'
cmake --build build/overseer-options --target bench_ompspmv --parallel 4'; then
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "status": "SUCCESS", "stage": "build", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'
else
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "status": "FAILURE", "stage": "build", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "build_failed", "server": "lair-cpu"}'
exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "stage": "run", "status": "PENDING", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'
failures=0
mkdir -p /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261014-013518-36302120764450/0001 || exit 1
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "start", "total": 2, "id": 1, "server": "lair-cpu", "parameters": {"dataset": "/u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/gupta3/gupta3.mtx", "threads": 4, "method": "openmp-double"}, "choices": {"dataset": "gupta3", "threads": "4", "method": "openmp-double"}}'
env OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 CPM_SOURCE_CACHE=/u/yuxihong/.cache/CPM srun --nodes=1 --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=4 bash -c 'printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "stage": "run", "status": "RUNNING", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'"'"'
exec /data/project/yuxilab/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/.omo/workspaces/41fb8bec5ebaa36bd3dc71d2dec6a49765b1d7a92396bfa22509c0ddd9d223da/source/build/overseer-options/bin/bench_ompspmv --matrix /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/gupta3/gupta3.mtx --threads 4 --index int32 --offset int32 --iterations 5 --max-time 0.05 --output /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261014-013518-36302120764450/0001/result.json --precision double' 2>&1 | tee /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261014-013518-36302120764450/0001/output.log
code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
printf '%s%s%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "finish", "id": 1, "server": "lair-cpu", "parameters": {"dataset": "/u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/gupta3/gupta3.mtx", "threads": 4, "method": "openmp-double"}, "choices": {"dataset": "gupta3", "threads": "4", "method": "openmp-double"}, "exit_code": ' "$code" '}'
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then failures=$((failures+1)); fi

printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "start", "total": 2, "id": 2, "server": "lair-cpu", "parameters": {"dataset": "/u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/pdb1HYS/pdb1HYS.mtx", "threads": 4, "method": "openmp-double"}, "choices": {"dataset": "pdb1HYS", "threads": "4", "method": "openmp-double"}}'
env OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 CPM_SOURCE_CACHE=/u/yuxihong/.cache/CPM srun --nodes=1 --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=4 bash -c 'printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "stage": "run", "status": "RUNNING", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'"'"'
exec /data/project/yuxilab/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/.omo/workspaces/41fb8bec5ebaa36bd3dc71d2dec6a49765b1d7a92396bfa22509c0ddd9d223da/source/build/overseer-options/bin/bench_ompspmv --matrix /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/pdb1HYS/pdb1HYS.mtx --threads 4 --index int32 --offset int32 --iterations 5 --max-time 0.05 --output /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261014-013518-36302120764450/0002/result.json --precision double' 2>&1 | tee /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261014-013518-36302120764450/0002/output.log
code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
printf '%s%s%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "finish", "id": 2, "server": "lair-cpu", "parameters": {"dataset": "/u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/pdb1HYS/pdb1HYS.mtx", "threads": 4, "method": "openmp-double"}, "choices": {"dataset": "pdb1HYS", "threads": "4", "method": "openmp-double"}, "exit_code": ' "$code" '}'
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then failures=$((failures+1)); fi
if [ "$failures" -eq 0 ]; then
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "stage": "run", "status": "SUCCESS", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'
else
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "stage", "stage": "run", "status": "FAILURE", "server": "lair-cpu", "allocation": "lair-cpu"}'
exit 1
fi
